datum: Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia.
Bear ye one another's burdens, * and so shall ye fulfil the law of God.

versus: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations.

datum: V. The Lord is my Shepherd, I shall not want.
R. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures.
Hold Thou me up, * O Lord, and I shall be safe.

versus: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.

datum: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Israël shall dwell safely: + and this is the name whereby she shall be called, * The Lord our Righteousness.
Remember us, O Lord, with the favour that Thou bearest unto Thy people.
R. O visit us with Thy salvation.
Let us approve ourselves * in much patience, in much fasting, by the armour of righteousness.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts, + and let him return unto the Lord, and He will have mercy upon him; * and to our God, for He will abundantly pardon.

versus: And under his feathers shalt thou trust.

datum: V. His truth shall be thy shield.
R. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night.
O My people, * what have I done unto thee, and wherein have I wearied thee? Testify against Me.

Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded; + let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed; * bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction, O Lord our God.

versus: And mine affliction from the horns of the unicorn.

datum: V. Make not my soul to perish with sinners, O God.
R. Nor my life with bloody men.
Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

Now is Christ risen from the dead, the first-fruits of them that sleep; + for since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead. * For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
V. The disciples were glad, Alleluia.
R. When they saw the Lord, Alleluia.
